title: Code Nexus
note: Subject v2.1. The test scenario is yours, so the script only has to run and show the subject's sections. The architecture is checked by importing your file: ABC with abstract validate / ingest, validate() per type, ingest() raising on bad data, output() giving (rank, str) oldest first, DataStream routing + stats replayed on the subject's batches, Protocol plugin + output_pipeline, valid CSV / JSON. Source: imports abc / typing only, type hints, flake8, mypy (the subject expects a mypy error on the invalid ingest test: warning only).

tests.name: runs without crashing, subject sections shown
DataProcessor is an ABC with abstract validate / ingest and a concrete output
code: assert issubclass(DP, abc.ABC), 'DataProcessor must inherit from ABC'
assert {'validate', 'ingest'} <= set(DP.__abstractmethods__), 'validate and ingest must be @abstractmethod (got %r)' % set(DP.__abstractmethods__)
assert 'output' not in DP.__abstractmethods__ and callable(getattr(DP, 'output', None)), 'output() must be a standard method of DataProcessor'
assert isinstance(err, TypeError), 'DataProcessor() should not be instantiable'
assert isinstance(cls, type) and issubclass(cls, DP), '%s must inherit DataProcessor' % name
assert 'validate' in vars(cls) and 'ingest' in vars(cls), '%s must override validate and ingest' % name
assert 'output' not in vars(cls), '%s: output() is not to be overridden' % name
assert ann not in (inspect.Parameter.empty, 'Any') and str(ann) != 'typing.Any', '%s.ingest(): the signature must reflect the accepted types, got %r' % (name, ann)
assert sig.return_annotation in (bool, 'bool'), 'validate() must return bool'
assert str(inspect.signature(DP.output).return_annotation).replace(' ', '') in ('tuple[int,str]',), 'output() must be -> tuple[int, str]'

tests.name: validate(): each processor accepts only its own kind of data
code: assert err is None, 'print_processors_stats() raised %r' % err
return [tuple(int(x) for x in re.search(r'total (\d+) items processed, remaining (\d+) on processor', ln).groups())
for ln in out.splitlines() if 'items processed' in ln]
cases = [(n, 42, True), (n, 3.14, True), (n, [1, 2.5, -3], True), (n, 'Hello', False), (n, ['a'], False), (n, log, False),
(t, 'Hello', True), (t, ['a', 'b'], True), (t, 42, False), (t, [1, 2], False), (t, log, False),
(lg, log, True), (lg, [log, log], True), (lg, 'Hello', False), (lg, 42, False), (lg, {'a': 1}, False)]
for proc, data, want in cases:
assert err is None, '%s.validate(%r) raised %r' % (type(proc).__name__, data, err)
assert got is want, '%s.validate(%r) should be %s, got %r' % (type(proc).__name__, data, want, got)

tests.name: ingest(): invalid data raises, valid data is stored item by item and output() gives (rank, str) oldest first
code: assert err is None, 'print_processors_stats() raised %r' % err
